outcome: percentages of MDSC in breast milk (BM-MDSC)
expression of activation markers on BM-MDSC
cohort: The participants were mothers of 86 preterm infants born between 23+0 and 36+6 weeks of gestation.
finding: Percentages of BM-MDSC positively correlated with gestational age and postnatal age, were lower in mothers who received antepartum tocolytics, and were strongly influenced by infant's sex, while the expression of activation markers on BM-MDSC decreased with postnatal age.
